Accept GitHub actor profile URL subresources

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-6
  description: |-
    ActorMetadata previously allowed only api.github.com/users/<login>, so real user objects with followers_url, repos_url, and similar subresource paths failed closed on in-scope search results. Accept verified users/<login>/… API families while still lease-checking nested repos and orgs URLs, and cover the full actor fixture in regression tests.
